newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: U.N. chief Annan praises Deng as reformer.
newsitem.headline: U.N. chief Annan praises Deng as reformer.

text.p: U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan expressed "deep sorrow" at the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping on Wednesday, calling him a key architect of modernisation and economic development.
"Deng Xiaoping has indelibly stamped his mark on this most recent and vibrant period of China's long history," Annan said in a statement.

"He will be remembered, not just in his own country, which he so faithfully served for so long, but also in the international community at large as a primary architect of China's modernisation and dramatic economic development."
Through his "dedicated leadership," Deng brought about major reforms "that have improved the lives of so many of his fellow citizens immeasurably," Annan said.
"This achievement will undoubtedly be seen by many to be his greatest legacy," he added.
Annan extended his "most profound condolences for this tragic loss" to Deng's family and the government and people of China.
